title: Full test coverage and traceability on every change
statement: Every change keeps 100% coverage and every active acceptance criterion proven by a passing test.

criteria.given: an active criterion with no passing test
criteria.then: it fails and names the criterion

criteria.given: a test tagged with an unknown criterion
criteria.then: it fails and names the test
lines, branches and functions must all be 100% covered on src/

criteria.given: a failing test for a criterion

criteria.then: reports/trace.json and reports/trace.md show every criterion's status
